role: ADR 005: records the August-September 2026 crash from unowned back-pointers in 28 split-out helpers and the decision that helpers are structs holding owners strongly, with a gate banning unowned.

units.key: § 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned
§ 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned > Context
units.does: Historical context: 28 helpers held unowned let back-pointers, which trapped when a Task/continuation outlived the owner (2026-09-02/03). Matches the history in scripts/check_no_unowned.sh:5-20; no unowned let/var remains in Emuqu/Sources or the watch app (only comments mention it).

units.key: § 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned > Decision
units.does: Claims helpers are structs built on demand by owners (collector.control, manager.writes, recorder.ticker), stored callbacks capture owner weakly, fire-and-forget tasks capture strongly, and check_no_unowned.sh fails on any unowned with verify_gates_fail.sh proving it. Verified: RRCollector.control (RRCollector.swift:139), HealthKitManager.writes (HealthKitManager.swift:42), WorkoutRecorder.ticker (WorkoutRecorder+TickerForwarding.swift:11) are computed builders; check_no_unowned.sh:26 greps 'unowned(unsafe)? let|var' in Emuqu/Sources and EmuquWatch Watch App; verify_gates_fail.sh:478-482 plants one.

flags.text: ADR says 'unowned is not used in app source' and the gate fails 'on any occurrence', but the gate regex only matches 'unowned let/var' declarations; an unowned capture list entry ([unowned self]) is not detected.

units.key: § 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned > Consequences
units.does: Claims helpers are stateless values and weak remains for optional back-references, citing WorkoutVoiceCoach, BeatConsistencyPriorsCache, TrainingMetricsCache. Verified: WorkoutVoiceCoach.swift:39/44 weak watchBridge/conversation, BeatConsistencyPriorsCache.swift:172 weak boundArchive, TrainingMetricsCache.swift:266 weak healthKit.
